APropos.title: About
APropos.intro: KO-LAB is not just an events company or a labour agency. We plan, build, install, equip and deploy complex projects.
APropos.ecosysteme_texte: You talk to one team. We mobilize the network.
APropos.positionnement_texte: Plan, build, install, equip, deploy. KO-LAB takes on complex projects from the first plan through to teardown, without multiplying the number of parties involved.
APropos.culture_titre: What gets decided in the office plays out in the field
APropos.culture_texte: Our crews work overnight, outside business hours, across several sites at once. Coordination isn't an add-on service — it's the job.
APropos.methode_1_texte: Not from a catalogue. What has to end up on the ground determines the crews, the means and the timeline.
APropos.methode_2_texte: Labour, equipment, fabrication at the LAB, network partners — assembled for the project, not imposed in advance.
APropos.methode_3_texte: Setup, support during the operation, teardown, removal and storage. The job ends when the site is handed back.
